author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Bathtub replacement can be tough. I like to self-level the floor if it’s wonky and fasten the tub to studs with special clamps. The plumbing is a lot easier with flexible waste overflows and the Delta valve in this tutorial. If you’re replacing a bathtub, make it easier with my online course at https://homerepairtutor.com/bathtub-and-shower-valve-installation/
